parameters.name: EnableBroadcast
parameters.description:
Specifies whether retained message broadcasting is supported.

- **true**: Supported.
- **false**: Not supported.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter has a value, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device that receives messages belongs.

parameters.name: TopicFullName
parameters.description:
The custom topic to which broadcast messages are sent.


- For <props="china"><ph>open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is the original custom topic of the device. For more information, see [Topic description](~~433806~~).
- For <props="china"><ph>non-open-source MQTT managed devices and </ph></props>non-MQTT cloud gateway devices, the custom topic is in the format of `/broadcast/${productKey}/${customField}`. The `${productKey}` value must be the same as the **ProductKey** request parameter, and `${customField}` is a custom field that you define.

><notice> 
- Topics are defined during device development and do not need to be created in the console.
- The operation permission of the topic must be **Subscribe** or **Publish and Subscribe**.

></notice>
